sources.section: Refresh declarations and invalidators; finite source-selected retention row

finite_scope: One declared check and one unchanged data dependency, two exact observed file populations, no claim of semantic coverage outside the supplied finite contract.

cases.discriminator: Original performed check is falsified on exact old subject/basis. All four current new-subject/new-basis preservation conditions are performed satisfied checks. Dependency and impact completeness are separate performed satisfied checks over the declared finite node/edge/material-source population. Actual old/current observation entries are equal.
Same positive finite frontier and actual original falsified result; claim_scope evaluation is explicitly null.

New subject changes the declared claim scope, and the same bound preservation predicate actually performs to falsified on current new subject/basis. The original check remains falsified on old subject/basis.

limits: Module controls supply finite F_P-owned scope and population; they do not prove completeness or semantic influence of an arbitrary codebase.
Protected memory resolver is a declared test control; actual check execution and exact input/evidence bytes are retained when custody is enabled.
